== Recent edits ==

First, let me say thank you very much for adding all of the House articles. I know how tedious and repetitive it is to create a lot of similar pages is. 

Second, I wanted to explain my recent edits to you so that there won't be any misunderstandings or anything.

On the House pages, if you go to the [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses category]], you'll see that they're alphabetized by the house name, and not all under the "H" section. Go into edit mode on any of them and you'll see that the category information on the right has some additional coding. Should look like this: <nowiki>[[Category:House Trakand|Trakand]]</nowiki>. Whatever is put after the "|" is a sortkey and will cause the page to be alphabetized under that instead of what it normally would be. 

Also, when adding the {{tl|short}} template, it isn't necessary to also add the category as well. The template automatically does that.

The Amyrlin Seat pages are kind of along the same lines as the short template. The only difference is that the {{tl|Character}} template will only add the [[:Category:Amyrlin Seats|Amyrlin Seats]] category if the "title" parameter is set to Amyrlin Seat, not the rank. A while back, it was discussed and settled on that the rank for those in the White Tower would be Novice/Accepted/Aes Sedai and the titles would be Amyrlin, Keeper, Ajah heads, Sitter, etc.

I know that the Character template isn't the most user-friendly of templates. Soon, I'll be creating a sub page that lists everything that gets categorized by the different parameters.

Again, thanks for creating the House pages and for all of your edits. They are much appreciated. If you have any questions, please let me know. Thanks again! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 02:25, December 23, 2011 (UTC)
